explanation: First Proof Problem 6 asks whether there is c > 0 such that every graph has an ε-light set (εL − L_S ⪰ 0) of size ≥ cε|V| for all 0 < ε < 1. G_S is encoded as the induced subgraph on S spanned back to V, so it keeps exactly the edges inside S. PosSemidef is applied to the symmetric real matrix. Spielman's Lemma B.1 in the paper answers yes, with c = 1/42 (stated for weighted graphs, so it covers simple graphs). The statement is correct and solved.
